rules.name: Perfect Warriors
rules.description: All non-vehicle Predators gain AP(+1) when they activate. They also gain Hurricane of Destruction, Paired Weapon (CC/HG), Paired Weapon (A/HG/SG), and Ranger.

rules.name: Trophy-Hunting
rules.description: When a Predator kills an enemy Character or Monster in Close Combat, the kill is worth an additional (+1) Mission Point.

rules.name: Bad Blood
rules.description: Gain Contempt (Predator) and Brutal. Gain +1 Mission Points for each enemy Predator squad that is 100% destroyed. Models lose the Trophy-Hunting ability and Elite lose Worthy Prey.

rules.name: Berserker
rules.description: May bring Berserker Yauja squads as Troops. May not bring Soldier squads.

rules.name: Dark Blade
rules.description: Armoury Weapons must gain the following for (+5) PTS: Glaive - ST(+1), Combi-Stick - DEF(+2), Plasmacaster – Armour-Piercing (+2), Smart Disc – (+1) Target. May not bring Trackers or Hellhounds.

rules.name: Elite
rules.description: Models in Blooded squads may purchase a 3’rd Weapon. May not bring Youngblood squads.

rules.name: Jungle Hunter
rules.description: Gain Grappling Hooks (4). May not bring Berserker squads.

rules.name: Killers
rules.description: May bring Alien Infant squads as Troops with a Squad Organization of 5-10 Infants. The Tracker’s “Master of Hounds” ability applies to friendly Alien Infant squads. May not bring Hellhound or Soldier squads.

rules.name: Death Walking
rules.description: If this model kills an enemy model in Close Combat and engages another enemy model in Close Combat with the Follow Up ability, it may immediately make an ROA(1) attack with one of its CC weapons against the new target. If that enemy is killed, it may Follow Up again and make one final ROA(1) attack against the new enemy. These additional attacks have Slow to Reload.

rules.name: Lone Wolf
rules.description: This model may not join a squad.

rules.name: Lone Wolf
rules.description: This model may not join a squad.

rules.name: Falconer
rules.description: This model may deploy a permanent Falcon token within 1” of it. The Falcon token has AP(1), counts as Flying, and may only use the Walk action. The Tracker may make Target Identifier (+2) tests from the Falcon token’s position. This model may only deploy 1 Falcon token per game.

rules.name: Master of Hounds
rules.description: Hellhound squads gain SP(+1), A(+1), and Ferocity (+1).

rules.name: Master of Hounds
rules.description: Alien Infant squads gain SP(+1), A(+1), and Ferocity (+1).

rules.name: Animal
rules.description: This model does not count as a Predator Type.

rules.name: Impervious
rules.description: Immune to Poison, Acid Blood, and Implant. Type(A) attacks are reduced by ST(-2).

rules.name: Paired Weapons(Blazer)
rules.description: Paired Weapons (X) - The model can use up to two of its equipped weapons of the (X) type in the same action. In ranged combat, both weapons have the same primary target. (X) can be a specific weapon, e.g. (combat knife), or a weapon type, e.g. (HG) or (CC).

rules.name: Paired Weapons(Hydra MMS)
rules.description: Paired Weapons (X) - The model can use up to two of its equipped weapons of the (X) type in the same action. In ranged combat, both weapons have the same primary target. (X) can be a specific weapon, e.g. (combat knife), or a weapon type, e.g. (HG) or (CC).

rules.name: Advanced Sensors
rules.description: Does not need to roll to reveal Stalking squads. Main Weapons always count as Battle Focused. May reroll to hit once with each Main and Secondary Weapon.

rules.name: Transatmospheric
rules.description: Recall. When activated next turn, this model may use Rapid Deployment.

rules.name: Yautja Transport
rules.description: May transport multiple squads. Predators may be transported as if they are SZ(0). May carry up to 6 Hunting Bikes for 3 slots of its Transport capacity each.

characteristics.name: RULES
characteristics.$text: Deadly, Precision(3), Slow to Reload, May hit up to 2 additional models within 5” of the Primary target of a Ranged Attack. Does not need LOS to secondary targets (Cover still applies).

characteristics.name: RULES
characteristics.$text: Model adds A(+2) against Acid Spit and is Immune to Acid Blood

sharedRules.name: Self-Destruct System
sharedRules.description: If the model is killed, roll a D20. On a 1-5, all models within 3” take a ST(13) autohit. A Predator reduced to W(1) may spend AP(3) to voluntarily activate it with no roll needed, but is killed automatically.

sharedRules.name: Worthy Prey
sharedRules.description: During the Control Phase of Turn 1, before Initiative is rolled, make a note of the highest PTS value enemy Character or Monster squad. If that Character or Monster squad is killed by this squad, and this squad inflicted 50% or more of the Wounds in Close Combat, you are awarded (+3) Mission Points. This replaces Trophy-Hunting for this squad.

rules.name: Master of the Hunt
rules.description: Blooded models gain Heal (4) and Elite models gain Duelist.

rules.name: Leader(1/Elite)
rules.description: Leader (X/Y) – If this model is your commander, you may take (X) of squad (Y) as Troop types. All other limitations remain.

rules.name: Leader(1/Berserker Yautja)
rules.description: Leader (X/Y) – If this model is your commander, you may take (X) of squad (Y) as Troop types. All other limitations remain.

rules.name: Worthy Prey
rules.description: During the Control Phase of Turn 1, before Initiative is rolled, make a note of the highest PTS value enemy Character or Monster squad. If that Character or Monster squad is killed by this squad, and this squad inflicted 50% or more of the Wounds in Close Combat, you are awarded (+3) Mission Points. This replaces Trophy-Hunting for this squad.

characteristics.$text: Armour-Piercing (5), Slow to Reload, Weapon Mode (Blast), RES(1): Critical Force (2)

rules.name: Dismounted
rules.description: If the Hunting Bike Weapon Controls, Flight Systems, or Engines are reduced to W(0), the Predator may dismount. For the rest of the game, he uses the Blooded profile with no additional Equipment, his remaining W equal to the remaining Rider W at the time he dismounts. Replace the Hunting Bike model with a Blooded model and then complete the appropriate effect for losing its W in that location. Unless it exploded, it becomes terrain for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Scything Drive-By
rules.description: Any enemy model in B2B with this model as it makes any movement action takes a single Close Combat hit by the Razor Pike. Roll to hit as normal. This model is immune to Free Slashes and may disengage with no penalties.

rules.name: Yautja Transport
rules.description: Predators may be transported as if they are SZ(0).
